body:
New stdlib-only research project `research/replicated-execution` (MIT): random k-fold replication with slashing against a colluding fraction β.

- Secret assignment makes cheating a coordination game; honesty is the unique equilibrium iff `S ≥ Gβ^{k−1}/(1−β^{k−1})`.
- Public assignment leaves `β^k` corruption at any stake.
- A leak probability λ leaves a `λβ^k` floor.
- 11 unit tests, and experiments checked against Monte Carlo. Includes a white paper, README, root README entry and portfolio page entry.
